text:
marta: Quick summary from the hallway tests today  trying a single 'Inference' parent in the left rail. Wireframes: https://img.redwood/mock/hallway-inference.png. Main takeaways: people like fewer top-level items, worried about bookmarks + breadcrumbs.

olivia: A11y feedback from testing: when a deep link opens a nested page the parent must expand and aria-expanded should be set. Screenreader users expect the H1 to be announced next; move focus to H1. Also ensure breadcrumb is a nav>ol>li with aria-current on active.

kevin: Router constraints: do not rely on hashes. Use real nested routes like /inference/models/:id and keep server-side redirects for older slugs. Preserve query params (critical for experiments). Example redirect plan: keep mapping for 120 days and emit telemetry when redirect occurs.

sam: Implementation bits: on route resolution, resolve redirects first, then synchronously expand parent nav before mounting page content. If expansion is async, render a skeleton until nav state is settled. Use history.replaceState for UI-only state changes so back button isn't noisy.

dan: Copy note: prefer the label 'Inference' for clarity and consistency with docs. Add short tooltip: "Models, deployments, and runtimes for serving models" to help non-ML folks. Also watch localization length.

marta: Mobile note: deep links should override a collapsed rail for the current session only. Do not change saved user preference.

olivia: QA checklist to add to the ticket: 1) deep-link with collapsed rail lands in content and sets focus to H1; 2) breadcrumb is semantic and screenreader announces full path (even if visually truncated); 3) keyboard nav works in icon-only mode with visible focus rings; 4) redirect preserves query params and logs telemetry; 5) reduced-motion respected for any expand animation.

kevin: Small UX: when a redirect occurs show a dismissible inline banner: "You were redirected from /models/123 to /inference/models/123" with a link to report if the bookmark is stale. Keeps users informed.

sam: Prototype deployed: https://deploy.redwood/pr/1987. Note: current preview still had a hash-based expand hack  I'll change it to route-driven expansion and pre-resolve redirects to avoid breadcrumb flashes.

marta: Thanks all. Action items: Sam implements pre-resolve + skeleton; Kevin drafts redirect TTL + telemetry; Olivia posts QA checklist; Dan runs microcopy through i18n. We'll check back after fixes. :thumbsup:
